# Webscraper io

WebScraper.IO is a web scraping tool that makes web data extraction easy and accessible for everyone through a cloud-based API.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/webscraper-io/.

## Actions

- **Create Sitemap**: Create a new sitemap configuration for web scraping.
- **Delete Sitemap**: Permanently delete a sitemap configuration from Web Scraper Cloud account.
- **Disable Sitemap Scheduler**: Disable automatic scheduling for a sitemap.
- **Enable Sitemap Scheduler**: Enable and configure automatic scheduling for sitemap scraping jobs.
- **Get Account Info** (read-only): Retrieve account information including email and page credits.
- **Get Scraping Jobs** (read-only): Retrieve all scraping jobs for the account with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Get Sitemap** (read-only): Retrieve a specific sitemap configuration by ID.
- **Get Sitemaps** (read-only): Retrieve all sitemaps for the authenticated account with pagination support.
- **Update Sitemap**: Update an existing sitemap configuration including structure, URLs, and selectors.
- **Get Sitemap Scheduler** (read-only): Retrieve scheduler configuration for a sitemap.
